dialogue-with-a-ghostspeak-amulet-equipp.player: I fought a really big ghost dog in here - is he gone now?

steps.text: If the player has a Shadow Sword:

steps.npc: You were well rewarded for you effort. But you should leave this place, for it is not wise to tarry.

steps.text: If the player has lost their Shadow Sword:

steps.player: But I lost my shadow sword and I don't know how to get it back.

steps.npc: Ah, so that is why you return. I can assist you in that and give you another.

dialogue-with-a-ghostspeak-amulet-equipp.npc: Yes, he is gone from this place. You did a great thing removing him.

dialogue-with-a-ghostspeak-amulet-equipp.player: Who are you anyway...or were you...?

dialogue-with-a-ghostspeak-amulet-equipp.npc: Who I was does not matter. Now, I am a guardian for the Shadow Realm and I am protecting this area from any more disturbances.
There are those who walk in the Shadow Realm who should not.
